# Precision Jiu Jitsu

> Precision Jiu Jitsu is a no gi jiu jitsu academy in Hudson, New Hampshire. Shawn Melanson is its head instructor, a black belt competitor and a BJJ Fanatics instructor.

This website serves people arranging local training and people exploring Shawn’s online instructionals. Full online courses are sold and accessed through BJJ Fanatics. Public samples and previews are separate from the full courses and from gym membership.

## Academy facts

1. Address: 14 Brady Drive, Unit 2, Hudson, NH 03051, United States.
2. Phone: +1 603 459 3610.
3. Email: precisionjiujitsu29@gmail.com.
4. Adult classes welcome all experience levels. Kids classes accept ages 5 and up.
5. The first class is free. Visitors should contact the gym and receive confirmation before attending.
6. A submitted trial request is not a confirmed booking. A course link click is not a confirmed sale.

## Local training

1. [Academy and complete schedule](https://precisionjiujitsunh.com/): Current adult, kids, open mat, wrestling and competition training sessions, member stories and enquiry form.
2. [Adult no gi jiu jitsu](https://precisionjiujitsunh.com/adult-no-gi-jiu-jitsu): Program, coaches, adult timetable and first visit questions.
3. [Kids jiu jitsu](https://precisionjiujitsunh.com/kids-jiu-jitsu): Ages 5 and up, class times and parent enquiry information.
4. [First class guide](https://precisionjiujitsunh.com/first-class): Contact, clothing, directions and visit confirmation.
5. [Shawn Melanson](https://precisionjiujitsunh.com/shawn-melanson): Instructor background, selected official competition results and published courses.

## Online instructionals

1. [Instructional library](https://precisionjiujitsunh.com/instructionals): Compare seven courses and explore public previews.
2. [Arm Bar It All](https://precisionjiujitsunh.com/instructionals/arm-bar-it-all): Arm attacks from several positions.
3. [Precision Wrestling For Jiu Jitsu](https://precisionjiujitsunh.com/instructionals/precision-wrestling-for-jiu-jitsu): Standing exchanges, ties and takedowns.
4. [Modernized Headquarters Passing](https://precisionjiujitsunh.com/instructionals/modernized-headquarters-passing): Headquarters passing routes and live round breakdowns.
5. [Precision Top Stuff](https://precisionjiujitsunh.com/instructionals/precision-top-stuff): Side control, mount, north south and submission connections.
6. [Butterfly Half and Knee Shield](https://precisionjiujitsunh.com/instructionals/butterfly-half-and-knee-shield): Half guard attacks and sweeps.
7. [Seated Sweeps and Wrestle Ups](https://precisionjiujitsunh.com/instructionals/seated-sweeps-and-wrestle-ups): Seated guard attacks and wrestling connections.
8. [Pass It All: The Leg Drag System](https://precisionjiujitsunh.com/instructionals/leg-drag-system): Leg drag control, counters and connected passing.

## Publisher and policies

1. [Shawn’s BJJ Fanatics catalog](https://bjjfanatics.com/collections/instructional-videos/fighter_shawn-melanson): Full course access, current pricing, reviews and purchase support. Refer to the publisher for changing commercial details.
2. [Privacy policy](https://precisionjiujitsunh.com/privacy): Website enquiries, optional providers, information requests and SMS disclosures.
3. [Cookie policy](https://precisionjiujitsunh.com/cookies): Map and external video preferences and browser storage.
4. [Terms and conditions](https://precisionjiujitsunh.com/terms): Website use, training enquiries, instructionals and text messaging terms.

Course descriptions are original curriculum summaries, not quotations from Shawn or reviews of complete courses. This file is a navigation aid. It does not replace page content, robots.txt, indexing directives or publisher terms.
